title: Price per unit of an HMO straight-tip catheter return credit: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
On the Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program, a return credit on straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) that were charged as a non-covered item is priced per unit. The price follows what the customer was actually charged.

## Pricing clause

Here, the charge is the non-covered item charge posted against the returned refill. The customer's own units are that refill's units above the plan's straight-tip limit of 150 units per 30 days for its supply days, with closed-system kits shipped on the same day counted against the same limit.

1. When a balance adjustment already stands against the charge, the price is replaced by the charge less that adjustment, divided by the customer's own units.
2. When no adjustment stands and the charge per customer unit is below the cash price of 1.85 USD, the price is replaced by the charge divided by the customer's own units. That is the price the customer actually paid.
3. Otherwise the price stays the cash price of 1.85 USD.

## Worked prices (hypothetical; 50 own units)

| Charge | Adjustment already against it | Price per unit |
|---|---|---|
| 92.50 USD | 30.00 USD | 92.50 less 30.00, divided by 50: 1.25 USD |
| 60.00 USD | none | 60.00 divided by 50 is 1.20 USD, below 1.85, so 1.20 USD |
| 92.50 USD | none | 92.50 divided by 50 is 1.85 USD, not below the cash price, so 1.85 USD |
